handedness.visual_basis: Face-on and DTL at address (tick 15) show left side closer to target (lead side left) and right hand trailing; typical right-handed setup.

temporal_orientation.visual_basis: Golfer at address, club behind ball, no movement visible.
Hands and club are lifting away from the ball compared with address; takeaway visible.
Continued motion away from the ball; club and hands farther from address.
Hands and club continue up and back; still moving away.
Hands near top and club transition visible; rotation changing toward the ball begins.
DTL shows near-top position; slight ambiguity whether start of down is at 25-28 but motion still high.
Hands near/at top in some frames; some frames show start of transition but overall still at/near top.
Club clearly moving back toward the ball from the top in both views.
Hands and club descending toward the ball; approach to strike visible.
Downswing continuation with hands moving toward ball; impact region approaching.
Frames show follow-through after contact; club past strike point.
Late follow-through / finish pose; club well past ball.
